reviewer: Independent curator/QA agent; visual layout inspection, not an additional scientific or commercial validation.
inspection_method: All 25 final pages were covered by Poppler PNG renders at 110 dpi and visual inspection at original detail. The scientific-text-freeze main build was fully checked, then the final layout-only main revision was rerendered: pages 1-3 were pixel-identical to already inspected pages and pages 4-17 were visually reinspected in seven two-page spreads. Final cover and abstract therefore inherit the exact inspected pixels; all final equations, tables, charts, section flow and references were covered. Brief and companion hashes remain unchanged from their completed two-page and six-page visual reviews.

fixes.defect: Eight-page companion had two mostly empty spill pages: section 1 tail and section 6 tail.
fixes.change: Top margin 22 to 20 mm; bottom margin 20 to 18 mm; paragraph gap 4 to 3 pt; table leading multiplier 1.08 to 1.04. Original 10 pt body font retained.
fixes.result: Exactly six pages with one substantive section per page.

fixes.defect: Narrow table label columns had conspicuous justified gaps; archive identity hash split with a two-character tail.
fixes.change: Ragged-right first two label columns in the opening table; explicit paragraph breaks after the three retained-hash labels.
fixes.result: Readable label spacing; full exact hashes on separate intact lines.

fixes.defect: Cover kicker flowed into the large title and a stray date day appeared beside the shaded callout.
fixes.change: Root added paragraph breaks after kicker and shaded callout.
fixes.result: Final cover title, branding, callout and complete date are separated cleanly.

fixes.defect: A five-line concluding paragraph occupied an otherwise empty page before a forced bibliography break.
fixes.change: Root removed the forced clearpage before bibliography.
fixes.result: Final main PDF is 17 pages; conclusion leads into references on page 16.

fixes.owner: QA agent with explicit root authorization after scientific text freeze
fixes.defect: The final abstract revision caused section 2.2 heading to appear on page 4 immediately before section 3 while its witness table floated to page 5.
fixes.change: Load float and needspace in paper.tex line 3; add Needspace{21 baselineskip} in body.tex line 47 before subsection 2.2; change only its table placement to H at body.tex line 50.
fixes.result: Heading 2.2, the complete witness table and its caption stay together on PDF page 5 before section 3. Main remains 17 pages, with no added orphan body page.

accepted_nondefects: Main PDF page 4 has bottom whitespace so that the complete section 2.2 witness block can start on page 5; page 4 still contains a substantive full section, not an orphan fragment.
The final reference page is partially filled; it is ordinary bibliography continuation, not an orphan body paragraph.
Remaining underfull TeX messages do not correspond to clipping or overlapping content in the inspected pages.
limits: Hashes bind this QA decision to these exact PDFs; rebuilding PDFs requires a fresh hash and any affected-page check.
No primary-data reanalysis, broad repository test campaign, claim rewrite, or translation certification was undertaken in this layout review.

main_final_layout_integrity.verification: Removing the added float/needspace package line and Needspace line and reversing the single witness-table H placement reproduces the saved pre-layout paper.tex and body.tex byte-for-byte.

main_review_revision_history.scope: Prior complete layout review after cover and bibliography fixes.
Root scientific text freeze, changed-page visual review and unchanged-page pixel comparison; detected witness heading/table separation.
Authorized final layout-only repair; pages 4-17 visually reinspected and pages 1-3 pixel-identical to already inspected renders; PASS.
